title: Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2610.22230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Meta deploys a heterogeneous fleet comprising NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and proprietary MTIA accelerators to reduce costs and mitigate vendor lock-in. However, the extensive history of NVIDIA-specific optimizations hinders performance portability to other hardware. This paper presents our methods for optimizing alternative accelerators, using AMD Instinct MI350X versus NVIDIA B200 for recommendation model training as a case study. We propose three reusable principles. First, hardware-model co-design is essential: rather than directly porting models from NVIDIA GPUs, revising model structures and software recipes allows full exploitation of accelerator-specific strengths (e.g., MI350X's 1.6x HBM capacity relative to B200). Second, our analytical performance model enables zero-warmup optimal kernel selection across diverse datatypes and matrix shapes in production models, drastically simplifying tuning. translated_title: 面向硬件多样性的架构设计：Meta在AMD GPU上实现高性能AI训练的端到端协同设计
translated_abstract: Meta部署了一个由NVIDIA GPU、AMD GPU和自研MTIA加速器组成的异构集群，以降低成本并缓解供应商锁定问题。然而，长期以来针对NVIDIA的深度优化阻碍了性能向其他硬件的可移植性。本文以AMD Instinct MI350X与NVIDIA B200在推荐模型训练上的对比为案例研究，介绍了我们优化其他加速器的方法。我们提出三个可复用的原则。第一，硬件-模型协同设计至关重要：与其直接将模型从NVIDIA GPU移植过来，不如修改模型结构和软件方案，以充分发挥加速器特有的优势（例如MI350X相对于B200拥有1.6倍的HBM容量）。第二，我们的分析性能模型能够在生产模型中跨不同数据类型和矩阵形状实现零预热的最佳内核选择，极大地简化了调优工作。第三，日益成熟的智能体工作流……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Meta提出硬件-模型协同设计、分析性能模型驱动的零预热内核选择和智能体工作流三大可复用原则，成功实现了推荐模型训练在AMD MI350X GPU上相对于NVIDIA B200的高性能优化移植。
en_tdlr: Meta presents three reusable principles—hardware-model co-design, analytical performance models enabling zero-warmup optimal kernel selection, and mature agentic workflows—to achieve high-performance portability of AI recommendation model training from NVIDIA B200 to AMD Instinct MI350X GPUs.
